intro: The Harvester is a quest initiated by discovering the severed head of a strange, alien insectoid predator in the southern Barrens. Bringing this unsettling specimen to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo reveals disturbing implications for the land's spiritual and ecological balance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the Barrens.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You seemed troubled, friend. How go your lessons in the Barrens? Did you find something that disturbs you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can tell nothing of the nature of this beast, for its spirit has fled. But as you guessed, it does not belong in the Barrens. I fear it may herald a grim future for our people...
But for now, prepare yourself, and let us hope that time unravels the mystery of this creature.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
